increment_paragraph: **GATEWAY-RULE-API** (pluggable-cards seam B, phase P2; [report](../../reports/gateway-rule-api/README.md)) adds `crates/qcore-gateway-rule-api` (query/result types, reason-key reservation, one trait per ROUTE-MAP position; depends on qcore-schemas and qcore-contract only), `crates/gateway-rules/registry.toml` with 17 rule rows in consultation order, generated route tables under a committed-equals-generated test (`scripts/gen_gateway_registry.py`), and the run-time switch `QCORE_GATEWAY_RULES_OFF` (user decision 3): a listed rule refuses, an unknown id refuses the whole list fail-closed, and the off-list is recorded in each run's component rule set and advertised to `quirin-audit measure`. No rule body moved. Identity: system byte-identical; corpus equal up to a one-to-one build-identity substitution (0 rows moved over 4,834); slice not re-measured on the merged base. A real `measure --rules-off 35` shows rule 35 carrying 12 corpus functions (incomplete run, not a ledger). The user merged the card at caef07e7b; the integrator completed its report from the hand-back.
status_paragraph: Gateway rules (2026-10-27, GATEWAY-RULE-API): consultation order now comes from `crates/gateway-rules/registry.toml` (17 rows) through generated tables, and `QCORE_GATEWAY_RULES_OFF` switches listed rules off at run time (unknown ids fail closed). No verdict changed; rule bodies still live in `qcore-c-gateway` until each pilot migration card moves one.

ledger.title: Hold positions are not yet switchable
ledger.text: GATEWAY-RULE-API made fallback positions switchable; hold positions (rule 32a's frame hold among them) need a decision on what 'off' means for a hold before rule 32a can migrate. DISCHARGE: a decision recorded in the plan and a switch with a test.

ledger.title: Compile-time arm constants remain
ledger.text: The 10n and ENUM_ARM compile-time constants were not trivially equivalent to a run-time switch and remain. DISCHARGE: each replaced by its registry row's switch with an identity run, in the migration card for its rule.

ledger.title: Pilot rule migrations
ledger.text: Card-recommended order: 35, 37, 36, 33, 34 (needs a transfer position first), 32a (needs GATEWAY-RULE-API-HOLD-OFF). `known_rule` refuses ledgers for 32a/33/34/36/37 until each migration registers its rule. DISCHARGE: each pilot lands as its own card with an identity run and a switch-measured contribution ledger.

ledger.title: Switch coverage of other entry points
ledger.text: The switch is read on the audit entry points the card wired; other binaries that consult the gateway tables do not yet record the off-list. DISCHARGE: every entry point records the off-list, with a test.

ledger.title: Slice identity not re-measured on the merged base
ledger.text: Identity-2 timed out before base/slice ran; identity-1 (base 5813ddab9) showed slice byte-identical. DISCHARGE: a slice comparison of main against the pre-card base, or the next landing publication showing the tail-pause profile unchanged.

ledger.title: Corpus build identity digests the side's working directory
ledger.text: Under `quirin-audit measure` each side's pinned corpus route runs in sides/<name>/work-corpus, and the unit build identity (projection.rs hypothesis_context) digests the working directory, so corpus artifacts are never byte-identical across sides and the tool reports composition-conflict for equal provenance. DISCHARGE: the tool runs every side's corpus at one fixed working directory, or the identity excludes it, with a byte-identity test.

GATEWAY-RULE-API ran a real `measure --rules-off 35`: the advertisement check passed and tip-off components record off = ["35"], but the run hit the 10 h quota before the post-run off-list check; rule 35 moves 12 corpus functions Safe -> Unknown, 0 system, 0 slice.

GATEWAY-RULE-API: consultation order is now generated from crates/gateway-rules/registry.toml (17 rows); W43-INDEX-TRAVERSAL and W44-INDIRECT-CALL-ARGUMENT-ACCESS are card names because no rule document exists for them.
